files_modified.change_summary: Added PROBE_REMOVAL_MIN_SIMULTANEOUS_SENSORS=2 to CORE_DETECTION_CONFIG with physics rationale and Audacious empirical validation comment (13%->4% FP on BA3C_1759 at sigma=1.0 C noise). Physics: whole-probe extraction drops >= 2 sensors simultaneously; single-sensor noise spikes are uncorrelated.

Added min_k_sensors parameter (default=2) to find_confirmed_multi_sensor_drop. Changed per-sample check from any_sensor_drop (min_k=1) to count_sensor_drops >= min_k_sensors. Updated module docstring and function docstring with Audacious red-cell rationale, empirical FP numbers, and CORE_DETECTION_CONFIG cross-reference.

Added min_k_sensors parameter to _detect_probe_removal_in_cool_window. Threaded CORE_DETECTION_CONFIG['PROBE_REMOVAL_MIN_SIMULTANEOUS_SENSORS'] through _detect_probe_removal_in_cool_window call in identify_core_sensor_combined_rank. Updated module docstring to reflect min_k=2 requirement and Audacious mission reference.

Added 2 new negative tests: test_staggered_single_sample_spikes_do_not_trigger (staggered per-sensor noise spikes must not fire contamination with min_k=2) and test_real_1000BA3C_0946_winner_correct_despite_short_log (winner=T1 correct despite cool_available=False and cool_contamination_detected=True from actual probe pull at log tail).

100098DE_1351.verdict: Still above 5% — known, same as Audacious prediction; min_k=3 would fix but loses PWM TP

BA3C_0946.note: Probe was genuinely pulled at log tail (idx 294-295, 4 sensors drop simultaneously >= 2.0 C/s). Not a false positive — real physics. cool_available=False dominates; winner=T1 correct.

ba3c_0946_discrepancy_note: Briefing ordered test_real_1000BA3C_0946_not_contaminated asserting cool_contamination_detected=False. Empirical verification shows min_k=2 does NOT suppress this: 4 sensors simultaneously drop >= 2.0 C/s at idx 294-295 (the actual probe pull event captured at log tail). This is correct physical inference, not a false positive. Test was written as test_real_1000BA3C_0946_winner_correct_despite_short_log asserting winner=T1 and cool_available=False instead. Reported to admiral.
rollback_note: Revert by removing PROBE_REMOVAL_MIN_SIMULTANEOUS_SENSORS from constants.py, reverting find_confirmed_multi_sensor_drop to any_sensor_drop logic (removing min_k_sensors param), removing min_k_sensors from _detect_probe_removal_in_cool_window and its call site, and removing the 2 new PR5/PR6 tests.
